jfk.text: And so my fellow Americans ask not what your country can do for you, ask what you can do for your country.

librispeech-1272-128104-0004.text: Linels' pictures are a sort of up-guards and Adam paintings, and Mason's exquisite idols are as national as a jingo poem. Mr. Burke fosters landscapes, smiling at one much in the same way that Mr. Carcor used to flash his teeth.
